# Tego Saputra Portfolio

Portfolio website for Tego Saputra, a full-stack web developer focused on React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Supabase projects.

## Project Highlights

- ABSENAPEL: smart attendance application with GPS validation, selfie proof, permission flow, and admin dashboard.
- CARIMAKAN: local food ordering application with menu catalog, cart, checkout, favorites, reviews, order history, and admin panel.
